# YapMate - Chrome Web Store Listing

## Title
YapMate - AI Twitter Reply Generator

## Short Description
Generate authentic crypto Twitter replies with AI. Choose your tone, get perfect responses with handles, tickers, and hashtags.

## Detailed Description
🚀 **Transform Your Twitter Engagement with AI-Powered Replies**

YapMate is the ultimate Chrome extension for crypto Twitter enthusiasts who want to engage authentically and efficiently. Generate perfect replies that sound natural, include relevant project mentions, and match your desired tone.

**✨ Key Features:**
• **4 Tone Options**: Smart, Funny, Serious, or Degen - match any conversation style
• **Auto Project Detection**: Automatically includes relevant @handles, $tickers, and #hashtags
• **One-Click Integration**: Seamlessly adds "Reply with AI" buttons to every tweet
• **Copy & Rewrite**: Easy copy-to-clipboard and instant reply variations
• **Fallback System**: Works even when offline with smart backup responses
• **Privacy First**: Your API key stays local, no data sent to our servers

**🎯 Perfect For:**
- Crypto Twitter power users
- Community managers
- Traders and analysts
- Anyone wanting better Twitter engagement

**🔧 How It Works:**
1. Install the extension and add your free OpenRouter API key
2. Browse Twitter normally - see "Reply with AI" buttons on tweets
3. Click to select a tweet, choose your tone
4. Get an authentic, engaging reply in seconds
5. Copy and paste into Twitter's reply box

**🔒 Privacy & Security:**
- Your API key is stored locally in Chrome
- No tweet data stored or tracked
- All processing through secure OpenRouter API
- Open source and transparent

**💰 Cost-Effective:**
- Uses free OpenRouter API (Gemini 2.0 Flash)
- No subscription fees
- Pay only for what you use (typically pennies per month)

**🚀 Get Started:**
1. Get a free API key from openrouter.ai
2. Configure in extension settings
3. Start generating amazing replies!

Join thousands of users already boosting their Twitter engagement with YapMate!
